parsed.post: Significant gain from increasing DEPTH to 6 (val_bpb 1.057 vs 1.105 baseline). Increasing model capacity seems highly effective even within the 5-minute constraint. Next, I will investigate if increasing MATRIX_LR or adding WARMUP_RATIO helps stabilize this larger model.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 (from last experiment) and testing slightly higher learning rate with a warmup ratio to stabilize the larger model.
